description: Department of Forest Conservation - Forest Conservation Ordinance Order Released the Block of the Forest of the Kankamkulam Reserved Forest From 07.08.2024.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the release of a block of forest land (38.0 hectares total) from reserved forest status. While it mentions the Minister's name and title, this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is land administration and status change. The content fits the Land Gazette category as it involves land status changes, boundary descriptions, and property matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
